limits: No real Atlassian, GitLab or other provider credential/consent/live connection was used.
The manual probe does not write the database, import catalog entries, allocate capacity or run a synchronization worker.
Atlassian uses only the non-mutating POST search endpoint. GitLab uses only GET on fixed GitLab.com routes.
Rust HTTP fixtures and Node process fixtures were tested separately. Artifact smoke rejects invalid tokens before any network request.
Captures are bounded to 1000 rows and 16 pages. Provider pagination is not an atomic snapshot. Counts do not prove purchased capacity or provisioning.
An initial full Node run had one unrelated route-test failure; that suite passed in isolation and the full rerun passed.
JetBrains implementation requires the selected product variant, instance URL and its public API contract; these were requested but not supplied during this run.
GitLab Self-Managed/Dedicated hosts are not implemented.
The pre-existing OpenBao synchronization outage was not repaired.
